field: Brynnhildr Eriksson · what her wife calls her
note:
TORIE CALLS HER BRYNNIE. The Archive had VALKYRIE in the nicknames field and used it in her wife's mouth, which stacks the word three deep on one woman: THE VALKYRIE is her title, VALKYRIE is her Build Class, and Valkyrie was then also supposed to be the soft thing Torie says into her shoulder. NOBODY'S WIFE CALLS HER BY HER CLASSIFICATION.

AND THE SHAPE OF THE PAIRING IS IN THE TWO NAMES. Bryn calls her BRAT QUEEN as a title and MINX as a nickname — both of them naming what Torie DOES. Torie calls her BRYNNIE, which names nothing she does at all. It is just her name made smaller and warmer, which is what you do to a woman everyone else finds enormous.

SAME FAILURE AS THE REST OF THE MORNING, SMALLER: THE ARCHIVE REACHED FOR THE GRANDEST AVAILABLE WORD. Valkyrie sounded like devotion. Brynnie IS devotion.
